note: Fuzzer parses the 3-line input: source proj string, destination proj string, coordinates. The source proj string '+proj=isea' is accepted as the intended input format.
pj_transform invokes the forward transform of the source projection (isea) on the input coordinates.
The isea forward projection calls isea_forward with the input longitude/latitude.
isea_transform calls isea_snyder_forward to determine the icosahedral triangle.
The loop runs i from 1 to 20. icostriangles has only 20 elements (indices 0-19), so icostriangles[20] is an out-of-bounds read. The index is not validated to be within the array bounds.
invariant: loop index i must be within the bounds of the icostriangles array (0..19)
